book.name: Luk
book.title: To Nafa We Luk E Sa꞉sa꞉lo꞉

content: Luk eyo꞉ malolo꞉ we Tiofelas emo꞉ sa꞉sa꞉liga꞉fo꞉
Gode Elo꞉ o꞉gdo꞉ ni us amilo꞉ hendele fa꞉la꞉do alifelo꞉ a꞉no꞉ Godeya꞉ ene nanog dian kaluwa꞉ inin siya꞉lo꞉ ba꞉da꞉i mio꞉ a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ widabiki, kalu nolba꞉yo꞉ towo꞉ a꞉na sa꞉sa꞉lo꞉.
A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ niyo꞉ to tamin amilo꞉ sa꞉la꞉i mio꞉ a꞉no꞉ agele ba꞉da꞉ga꞉yo꞉, niyo꞉ malolo꞉ a꞉no꞉ dinafa sa꞉sa꞉lo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, kalu alan, Tiofelas giyo꞉ to we agelema꞉ki, gemo꞉ sa꞉sa꞉liga꞉fa꞉no꞉.
Gemo꞉lo꞉ to wido꞉ a꞉no꞉ giyo꞉ hendele a꞉la꞉asuluma꞉ki, niyo꞉ to we a꞉na sa꞉sa꞉liga꞉to꞉l.
Ma꞉mul kaluwo꞉ Sekalayamo꞉wo꞉ towo꞉ dinali sio꞉

Ha꞉lod e misa꞉ kalu iliki, Yudia hendo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉len ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉, bobalo꞉ so꞉mea꞉sen kalu nowo꞉, ene wiyo꞉ Sekalaya ko꞉lo꞉ elen. E Abiyaya꞉ eso꞉lo꞉wa a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ mio꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, nanogo꞉ diakiyo꞉, Abiyaya꞉ eso꞉lo꞉ o꞉lia꞉ egele dia꞉sen. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ene inga Elisabed elo꞉ A꞉lona꞉ ene so꞉lo꞉wa a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉.
A꞉la꞉yo꞉ Godeya꞉ ele saefa꞉ o꞉lia꞉ ene to man o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ mada tambo kudu ha꞉na꞉liki, Godeya꞉ si wa꞉l amio꞉ a꞉la꞉yo꞉ digalo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ elen.
Ko꞉sega Elisabed e faino dowabiki, a꞉la꞉yo꞉ so꞉walo꞉ma, anaso꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ elen.

Ho꞉len no amio꞉ Sekalaya e o꞉lia꞉lo꞉ nanogdo꞉ dia꞉sen kalu iyo꞉ nanogo꞉ dimidabikiyo꞉, Sekalaya eyo꞉lo꞉ Godeya꞉ siwa꞉l amio꞉ bobalo꞉ so꞉mea꞉sen nanog a꞉no꞉ dimido꞉. Iliyo꞉ bobalo꞉ so꞉mea꞉sen kaluwa꞉ man a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ kudu ha꞉naki, Godeya꞉ malilo꞉ a us a꞉namilo꞉ mundo꞉ so꞉fea꞉no꞉ a꞉no꞉ abe tina꞉nigaba꞉le a꞉la꞉liki, Godemo꞉ da꞉fema꞉ki, iyo꞉ ibuwo꞉ a꞉na goda꞉sa꞉ga꞉ sili ko꞉lo꞉, Sekalaya e tiniabiki, malilo꞉ a usamio꞉ e tiane.
Mun nafalo꞉ da꞉ba꞉no꞉ ho꞉lendeyo꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowabiki, Isolael kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ ha꞉la꞉ya kegea꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Godemo꞉ dulugu sa꞉la꞉labikiyo꞉, Sekalaya e mundo꞉ da꞉ba꞉no꞉ a꞉no꞉ so꞉fa꞉ni tiane.
E a usa sofea꞉liki ba꞉ba꞉ amio꞉, Godeya꞉ ma꞉mula꞉ kalu imilise nowo꞉, mun nafalo꞉ so꞉mea꞉sen mu gulu ililib doba꞉da꞉ kagafo꞉lena ba꞉ba꞉.
Sekalaya e ba꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉ iligakiyo꞉, tagio꞉ alan dowo꞉

Ko꞉sega ma꞉mul kalu eyo꞉ emo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Sekalaya, ge tagila꞉so꞉bo! Gilo꞉ Godemo꞉lo꞉ dulugu sio꞉wo꞉ Eyo꞉ dabu ko꞉lo꞉, ga꞉ ga Elisabed eyo꞉ kalu so꞉wayo꞉ sa꞉la꞉lia꞉ib. Giyo꞉ so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ wiyo꞉ Yo꞉n wikila꞉bi.

So꞉wa gilo꞉ sa꞉la꞉lia꞉nigab a꞉ma꞉yo꞉, ga꞉go꞉ mada sagale alifa꞉ib. Godeya꞉ si wa꞉l amio꞉ e halaido꞉ doma꞉ib ko꞉lo꞉, e sa꞉la꞉lialikiyo꞉, kaluka꞉isale modo꞉wo꞉ sagalema꞉ib. E wain ho꞉n o꞉lia꞉ aluna꞉ ho꞉n o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ mea꞉so꞉bo. E anowa꞉yo꞉ sa꞉la꞉lialikiyo꞉, Mama Malilo꞉ a꞉no꞉ e amio꞉ wa꞉lifo꞉ a꞉no꞉ko꞉ dofo꞉mela꞉ib.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ eyo꞉ Isolael kaluka꞉isale modo꞉wo꞉ nodoma꞉ki dimida꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Gode Alan inido꞉le a꞉no꞉ a꞉na tililia꞉ mia꞉ib.

Eyo꞉ Elaiyaya꞉ man o꞉lia꞉ halaido꞉ o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ o꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ dia꞉ga꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowalikiyo꞉, eyo꞉ Alano꞉ mea꞉nigaka꞉ a꞉la꞉likiyo꞉ tamina ha꞉na꞉ib. Yo꞉n eyo꞉ iya ima꞉yo꞉ so꞉wa o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ ha꞉fa꞉nolo mesea꞉ki ta꞉fa꞉ib. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ eyo꞉ yo꞉le dosodan kalu nolo꞉ asulo꞉ ilido꞉wo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉ nodo alitalikiyo꞉, iyo꞉ digalo꞉ kaluwa꞉ man a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ kudu hamana꞉ki ta꞉fa꞉ib. Kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ Alan mia꞉nigab a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ dimidalima꞉ki, Yo꞉n e a꞉na mia꞉ib.”
Ma꞉mul kaluwa꞉yo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, Sekalaya eyo꞉ ma꞉mul kalumo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉dabu ba꞉ba꞉, “Na꞉no꞉ anaso꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ niyo꞉ to gilo꞉ sa꞉lab ko hendele fa꞉la꞉doma꞉ib a꞉la꞉bo꞉, waga a꞉la꞉ ba꞉ba꞉no꞉wo꞉?”
Ma꞉mul kalu eyo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉yo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ne Ga꞉biol. Ne Godeya꞉ ene wo꞉lokan amilo꞉ dowa꞉seno꞉ ne ko꞉lo꞉, to nafa we ge dabuma꞉ki, Gode eyo꞉ ne wena iliga꞉fo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ sa꞉ma꞉ni mio꞉.
Ge nilo꞉ to so꞉lo꞉l we mo꞉tilida꞉dab ko꞉lo꞉, o꞉go꞉ ge do꞉fo꞉f dowaki, towo꞉ mo꞉toma꞉ib. To nilo꞉ so꞉lo꞉l we hendele fa꞉la꞉dowalikiyo꞉, ge towo꞉ a꞉na a꞉tola꞉ma꞉ib” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
A꞉no꞉ elo꞉wa fa꞉la꞉dowabiki, kaluka꞉isale iliyo꞉ Sekalaya e yasisen ko꞉sega, ofa꞉si modo꞉wo꞉ Sekalaya e malilo꞉ a us a꞉naka o꞉a꞉labiki, iliyo꞉ wangaba꞉le a꞉la꞉liki kele asulo꞉.
Sekalaya e ha꞉la꞉ya handalowakiyo꞉, e mego꞉fo꞉ do꞉fo꞉f dowo꞉. Eyo꞉ towo꞉ mo꞉tolaki, imo꞉wo꞉ dagiya꞉ da꞉feabiki, ili asulakiyo꞉, e malilo꞉ a us a꞉namio꞉ kelego꞉ nowo꞉ ho꞉le ba꞉ba꞉lo꞉b a꞉la꞉asulo꞉.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ nanog elo꞉ a꞉namilo꞉ dia꞉no꞉wo꞉ kedetabiki, Sekalaya e a꞉ma꞉la꞉ ene hena ane.

A꞉ma꞉la꞉ ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉, ene aya sen amio꞉, inga Elisabedo꞉ so꞉wayo꞉ a꞉na alelo꞉. Alela꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, Elisabed eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Kalu Alana꞉yo꞉ hendele nemo꞉wo꞉ nafale dimido꞉. Ne amilo꞉ kaluka꞉isaleya꞉lo꞉ sendelo alifa꞉ a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ dilaki go꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, Gode eyo꞉ ne mada sagale alifa꞉.” Eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉asulakiyo꞉, e ele bila꞉fo꞉ a꞉namio꞉ ene a ka sen.
Ma꞉mul kaluwo꞉ Maliamo꞉wo꞉ towo꞉ dinali sio꞉
Elisabed e alelo꞉wo꞉ ele do꞉go꞉fe a꞉la꞉fo꞉wo꞉ dufulabiki, Gode eyo꞉ ma꞉mul kalu Ga꞉biol e amisa꞉n Nasala꞉t, Ga꞉lili hen a꞉na iliga꞉fo꞉.
Gode eyo꞉ ma꞉mul kalu e, ga bolo꞉ kalu o꞉lia꞉lo꞉ mo꞉alila꞉sen elo꞉wa iliga꞉fo꞉. Ga a꞉ma꞉ wiyo꞉ Malia ko꞉lo꞉ e kalumo꞉ samefo꞉len. Kalu a꞉ma꞉ wiyo꞉ Yosa꞉b. E Da꞉ibida꞉ ene eso꞉lo꞉wa a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ mio꞉.
Ga꞉biolo꞉ ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Malialo꞉wa fa꞉la꞉dowaki a꞉la꞉sio꞉ “Malia, disi nafa. Gode eyo꞉ gemo꞉wo꞉ sagalaki, e ge o꞉lia꞉ sab” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Maliayo꞉ to a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉ iligakiyo꞉, to we o꞉bo꞉ngo꞉ sa꞉laigabele a꞉la꞉kele asulo꞉.
Ko꞉sega ma꞉mul kaluwa꞉yo꞉ emo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉ “Malia, ge tagila꞉so꞉bo. Gode eyo꞉ ge o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ sagalo꞉wo꞉ alan dowab.
Ge so꞉wayo꞉ alela꞉sa꞉ga꞉, kalu so꞉wa sa꞉la꞉lia꞉ib. So꞉wa a꞉no꞉ giyo꞉ Ya꞉su wikila꞉bi.

E kalu halaido꞉ doma꞉ib, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ kaluka꞉isale iliyo꞉ e Gode Iwalulo꞉ A꞉lab a꞉ma꞉ so꞉waka꞉, a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉mela꞉ib. Gode Alan eyo꞉, e ma꞉mu Da꞉ibid misa꞉ kalu sen o꞉leaumbo꞉, elo꞉ misa꞉ kalu mesea꞉ki, da꞉fe alifa꞉ib.
Ya꞉koba a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉lo꞉ so꞉lo꞉ mio꞉ a꞉no꞉, Ya꞉su E misa꞉ dowaki bo꞉fo꞉mela꞉ib. A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ elo꞉ bo꞉fo꞉likilo꞉ ha꞉nab a꞉no꞉ mo꞉elema꞉ib.”
A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, Malia eyo꞉ ma꞉mul kalumo꞉ dabu ba꞉daki, “Ne ga bolo꞉, kaluwo꞉ o꞉semo꞉ ane ko꞉lo꞉, to gilo꞉ sa꞉lab ko waga fa꞉la꞉doma꞉iba꞉le?”

Ma꞉mul kaluwa꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉ sa꞉laki a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Mama Malilo꞉ a꞉no꞉ gelo꞉wa mia꞉ib ko꞉lo꞉, Gode Iwalulo꞉ A꞉lab a꞉ma꞉ halaido꞉wa꞉yo꞉ ge go꞉lu alifa꞉ib. A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ malilo꞉ so꞉wa gilo꞉ sa꞉la꞉liab a꞉no꞉, Godeya꞉ Ene So꞉waleka꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉mela꞉ib.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ge so꞉lo꞉ amilo꞉ Elisabed, e anaso꞉ dowo꞉ ko꞉sega, o꞉go꞉ e alelo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ sab. Tamin amio꞉ e fainoka꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉sen ko꞉sega, o꞉go꞉ e alela꞉leno꞉ eleyo꞉ do꞉go꞉fela꞉fo꞉wo꞉ o꞉ma dufula꞉.
Mo꞉wo꞉ Gode eyo꞉ kelego꞉ tambowo꞉ o꞉li dimidama꞉ib.”
A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, Malia eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ne Alana꞉ ene nanogdo꞉ dian ga ko꞉lo꞉, eyo꞉ gilo꞉ sa꞉lab ko aumbo꞉ nemo꞉wo꞉ ka dimidama꞉ib.” A꞉la꞉do꞉ sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉, ma꞉mul kalu e a꞉na ta꞉fo꞉gane.
Maliayo꞉ Elisabedo꞉ ba꞉ba꞉ni ane
Ma꞉mul kaluwo꞉ ta꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ho꞉no꞉go꞉labiki, Malia e dimidalia꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Yuda hen misio꞉lo꞉ dosdo꞉ a꞉namida꞉ amisa꞉n nowa bo꞉bo꞉ge ane.
E ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowakiyo꞉, Sekalaya ene aya tina꞉sa꞉ga꞉, sagalo꞉ towo꞉ Elisabedmo꞉ sio꞉.
Elisabed e Maliaya꞉lo꞉ sagalo꞉ to sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉ dabu amio꞉, so꞉wa ko꞉lo꞉ kufa꞉ usamilo꞉ sen holoma꞉yo꞉ iligaki nanogo꞉ dimidabiki, Mama Malilo꞉ a꞉no꞉ Elisabed amio꞉ wa꞉lifo꞉.
Wa꞉lita꞉ga꞉, eyo꞉ towo꞉ halaido꞉ sa꞉laki, “Gode eyo꞉ ge mada sagale alifa꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ ka꞉isale nol sab we tambo, gi tininilab. So꞉wa gilo꞉ sa꞉la꞉lia꞉nigab ko, Gode eyo꞉ mada sagale alifa꞉ib.
Ne mo꞉ililo꞉ ga ko꞉sega ni Kalu Alana꞉ ano ge nelo꞉wa ya꞉sa꞉ga꞉, giyo꞉ ne ko꞉lo꞉ sagale alifa꞉.
Sagalo꞉ to gilo꞉ sa꞉lab a꞉no꞉ ne dabu amio꞉, so꞉wa ni kufa꞉ usamilo꞉ sab wema꞉yo꞉ sagalaki iligi dasilab.
Gode Elo꞉ gemo꞉lo꞉ to sio꞉ a꞉no꞉ hendele dimidama꞉ib a꞉la꞉bo꞉, giyo꞉ mada tilidabu ko꞉lo꞉, ge sagale alifa꞉.” Elisabed eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Maliayo꞉ sagalaki, Godeyo꞉ wabulu sio꞉.
Malia eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉,

content.text: “Ni asulo꞉wa꞉yo꞉ Gode Alana꞉ ene wiyo꞉ dulugu so꞉lo꞉l.
Ne ene nanog dian ga. Ne elo꞉ dianba, ko꞉sega
Eyo꞉ ne kanulu alitaki gasili ko꞉lo꞉,
No꞉no꞉n mamayo꞉ iliga꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Godemo꞉wo꞉ alan sagalab.
O꞉g wena a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ tif amio꞉lo꞉,
kaluka꞉isale ta꞉i ha꞉na꞉no꞉ a꞉ma꞉yo꞉
ne wilo꞉ di a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉mela꞉ib.
Mo꞉wo꞉ Gode Halaido꞉lelo꞉ A꞉lab eyo꞉ ne alan asuwa꞉taki nafale dimido꞉.
Ene wiyo꞉ malilo꞉ nafale dofo꞉mela꞉ib.
Kaluka꞉isale abeyo꞉ Godeyo꞉ tagilakilo꞉ wabulu sa꞉la꞉lab a꞉no꞉,
Godeya꞉ ene kanulo꞉ a꞉ma꞉ iyo꞉ go꞉lu alita꞉sen.
Kalu i a꞉ma꞉ ini so꞉wamo꞉wo꞉lo꞉, i ma꞉mu i ta꞉i ha꞉na꞉nigab o꞉mo꞉wo꞉lo꞉ a꞉la꞉ka dimida꞉i ha꞉na꞉mela꞉ib.
Gode ene dagiya꞉ nanog halaido꞉ dimido꞉.
Kalu inina꞉ma꞉la꞉yo꞉ asulo꞉ amio꞉ kailo꞉ dowab a꞉no꞉,
Gode eyo꞉ ha꞉la꞉ya o꞉luga꞉felo꞉.
Misa꞉ kalu nolo꞉ enena꞉ma꞉la꞉yo꞉ alan dowab a꞉no꞉, Gode eyo꞉ iyo꞉ ha꞉ga ta꞉felo꞉ ko꞉sega,
wilo꞉ma kalu a꞉no꞉ iwalu halona wabulun ta꞉felo꞉.
Kalu maiyo꞉ alando꞉ a꞉lab i a꞉no꞉, Gode eyo꞉ ilili alifa꞉ ko꞉sega,
kalu kelego꞉wo꞉ modo꞉lo꞉ da꞉lab i a꞉no꞉, madalile iliga꞉felo꞉.
Eyo꞉ ene nanog dian kaluka꞉isale Isolael a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ asufa꞉.
Imo꞉wo꞉ nofolo꞉wo꞉ alan wida꞉sen.
Dinali sio꞉ a꞉no꞉ Gode eyo꞉ Ablaham o꞉lia꞉ ene eso꞉lo꞉wa a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉lo꞉ ta꞉i ha꞉na꞉mela꞉ib i o꞉mo꞉ sio꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ asuwa꞉ta꞉mela꞉ib.”

content: Malia eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉wabulu sio꞉.
Maliayo꞉ e Elisabed o꞉lia꞉ seno꞉, ele otaleno꞉ dufula꞉sa꞉ga꞉, e a꞉ma꞉la꞉ ene hena ane.
Elisabed eyo꞉ Yo꞉no꞉ sa꞉la꞉li
Elisabed e, so꞉wayo꞉ sa꞉la꞉lia꞉no꞉ ho꞉leno꞉ dowabiki, eyo꞉ kalu so꞉wa ko꞉lo꞉ sa꞉la꞉li.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Elisabed ene eso꞉lo꞉ o꞉lia꞉ ene amisa꞉n o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ Gode eyo꞉ emo꞉wo꞉ nofolaki asufa꞉ a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉, iliyo꞉ e o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ sagalo꞉wo꞉ alan dowo꞉.
Sa꞉la꞉lia꞉sa꞉ga꞉ a꞉namio꞉, ho꞉len agelo꞉wo꞉ o fa꞉la꞉dowabiki, so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ do꞉go꞉fo꞉ hege gedema꞉ni mio꞉. Iliyo꞉ so꞉wa we iya Sekalaya ko꞉ wikilima꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉ ko꞉sega,
ene anowa꞉ sa꞉laki, “Iyayo꞉ mo꞉wikilima꞉no. Niliyo꞉ so꞉wa we, Yo꞉n wikilima꞉niki” a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, iliyo꞉ emo꞉wo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Ge so꞉lo꞉ us amio꞉ wi ko꞉ngo꞉wo꞉ tamin amio꞉ mo꞉wikila꞉sen.”
A꞉la꞉sa꞉labiki, iyaya꞉ asulo꞉wa꞉yo꞉ so꞉wa we wiyo꞉ o꞉b ko꞉lo꞉ wikilima꞉nigaya a꞉la꞉liki, ene asulo꞉wo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ dabu ba꞉dakiyo꞉, iliyo꞉ dagiya꞉ da꞉fe kedaka emo꞉wo꞉ a꞉na dabu ba꞉ba꞉.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Sekalaya eyo꞉ mo꞉fo꞉s nowo꞉ dimina꞉ki, dagiya꞉ da꞉feyo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, mo꞉fo꞉s a꞉namio꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉sa꞉lo꞉ “Ene wiyo꞉ Yo꞉n.” A꞉la꞉sa꞉sa꞉labiki, iyo꞉ tambo mada mologa꞉ifelo꞉.
Wigibo a꞉naka Sekalaya e do꞉fo꞉f elen a꞉no꞉ kolaetabiki, e towo꞉ tolaki, Godeya꞉ wiyo꞉ a꞉na dulugu sio꞉.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ene amisa꞉n kalu iliyo꞉ mada molo asulaki, Yudia hen misio꞉lo꞉ doba꞉da꞉lo꞉ ta꞉i ane a꞉no꞉ dimido꞉ a꞉no꞉ da꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, iliyo꞉ nenela꞉i ane.

Kalu dimido꞉ o꞉lo꞉ dabu i a꞉no꞉ tambo kele asulakiyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Tif amio꞉ kalu so꞉wa we o꞉bo꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ fa꞉la꞉doma꞉nigaba꞉le?” a꞉la꞉asulo꞉. Mo꞉wo꞉ Godeya꞉ ene dagi wa꞉la ta꞉fo꞉liki, so꞉wa we a꞉na tili dofo꞉len.
Tif amilo꞉ fa꞉la꞉doma꞉ibo꞉ Sekalaya eyo꞉ dinali sio꞉
Godeya꞉ Mama Malilo꞉wo꞉ Sekalaya e amio꞉ wa꞉lifo꞉liki, eyo꞉ dinali sa꞉lakiyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉.

content.text: “Isolaela꞉ Gode a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ ene kaluka꞉isalelo꞉wa ya꞉sa꞉ga꞉, niyo꞉ ga꞉li mesea꞉ki gasili ko꞉lo꞉,
niliyo꞉ Alana꞉ wiyo꞉ dulugu sa꞉ma꞉niki.
Gode eyo꞉ nilo꞉ gasilia꞉no꞉ kalu halaido꞉ nowo꞉ nimo꞉ dimi.
Kalu a꞉no꞉ Godeya꞉ ene nanog dian kalu Da꞉ibida꞉ ene eso꞉lo꞉wa a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉.
Tamina Gode enedo꞉ dinali sa꞉lan kaluwa꞉yo꞉ a꞉la꞉dinali sio꞉ ko꞉lo꞉,
o꞉go꞉ to we hendele fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉.
Ni o꞉lia꞉lo꞉ gisdo꞉ dimida꞉lab o꞉lia꞉
nimo꞉lo꞉ kulufa꞉yab kalu o꞉lia꞉ma꞉ dagi amilo꞉ elen a꞉no꞉
kalu wema꞉yo꞉ nio꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ asuwa꞉taki, a꞉ma꞉la꞉ gasili.
Elo꞉ dinali sio꞉ a꞉no꞉ asulufo꞉liki,
ene nofolo꞉ a꞉no꞉ nili ma꞉mu imo꞉ widaki go꞉.
Dinali saefa꞉ a꞉no꞉, Gode eyo꞉ nili ma꞉mu Ablaham o꞉lia꞉ dinali saefa꞉.
Nio꞉ gisa꞉ dagi usamilo꞉ elen a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ fage alitakiyo꞉,
enedo꞉ dinali sio꞉ a꞉la꞉ka go꞉.
A꞉la꞉go꞉ko꞉lo꞉ nio꞉ mo꞉tagilaki, ene nanog dia꞉melea꞉ki ta꞉fo꞉.
Nio꞉ nanogo꞉ dimidakiyo꞉, ho꞉leno꞉ tambo malilo꞉ dofo꞉liki, man digalo꞉ a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ kudu ha꞉na꞉melea꞉ki ta꞉fo꞉.”
“A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ni so꞉wa Yo꞉n ge, Gode Iwalulo꞉ a꞉ma꞉ dinali sa꞉lan kaluwo꞉ geka꞉ a꞉la꞉sa꞉ma꞉ib.
Alano꞉ o꞉mia꞉nigab amio꞉, elo꞉ mia꞉no꞉ tog a꞉no꞉ fadama꞉niki, ge ko꞉le ha꞉na꞉ib.
Gode eyo꞉ kaluka꞉isale enedo꞉wo꞉ a꞉ma꞉la꞉ gasilima꞉kiyo꞉,
mogago꞉ inido꞉ dimida꞉sen a꞉no꞉ ga꞉lila꞉ma꞉ib.
Iliyo꞉ a꞉la꞉asuluma꞉kiyo꞉, giyo꞉ wida꞉liki ha꞉na꞉ib.
Nili Gode eyo꞉ ni o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ ha꞉sa dowaki, nofolo alita꞉sen ko꞉lo꞉,
nio꞉ a꞉na a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ gasili.
A꞉la꞉go꞉ko꞉lo꞉ Godeya꞉lo꞉ Da꞉feyo꞉ kalu a꞉no꞉ ofa꞉ ya꞉no꞉ o꞉ngo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ Hebene halona a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ni o꞉lia꞉ mesa꞉no꞉ mia꞉nigab.
Kaluka꞉isale sololi usa siliki, soma꞉no꞉wo꞉ tagilakilo꞉ sab i a꞉no꞉, ho꞉ a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ ho꞉le alifa꞉ib.
A꞉la꞉gakiyo꞉ ha꞉salo꞉ mesa꞉no꞉ tog nafa a꞉no꞉ eyo꞉ imo꞉wo꞉ walama꞉ib.”

content: Sekalaya eyo꞉ to a꞉no꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉.

Tif amio꞉ so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ kalu alan dowalikiyo꞉, ene mamayo꞉lo꞉ halaido꞉ dowo꞉. E kalulo꞉ma kalaleli hen a꞉na ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉ silikiyo꞉, Isolael kaluka꞉isaleya꞉ siwa꞉l amilo꞉ fa꞉la꞉doma꞉no꞉ ho꞉len a꞉no꞉ yasilakiyo꞉ a꞉na sen.

footnotes.text: 1.31 Ya꞉su a꞉la꞉do꞉ wikilo꞉ a꞉ma꞉ ha꞉go꞉ we, Kalu Alan a꞉ma꞉la꞉ gasilian. Wi imilig a꞉no꞉ Hibulu to amio꞉ Yo꞉sua a꞉la꞉sa꞉la꞉sen. A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉, Ya꞉su o꞉lia꞉ Yo꞉sua o꞉lia꞉ a꞉ma꞉ ha꞉go꞉ imilise a꞉lab.
